verified_facts.text: The Fairmont Serenity Room faces the Palm sea and includes access to the Thermal Oasis, a wellness breakfast by Zest served in the room and 30% off massages at Serenity Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find tranquility with our palm sea facing room by Serenity Spa, which includes access to the Thermal Oasis, a wellness breakfast by Zest served in the room, signature wellness minibar amenities, and 30% off on massages at Serenity Spa.

verified_facts.text: Fairmont Gold rooms and suites give access to the Fairmont Gold lounge, which has sea views and offers breakfast, afternoon tea, happy hour and evening canapés.
verified_facts.excerpt: providing access to the luxury of Fairmont Gold lounge with its stunning sea views, featuring breakfast, afternoon tea, happy hour and evening canapés.

verified_facts.text: One and two bedroom apartments are located within the hotel, with a fully equipped kitchen and access to the gym, outdoor pools, private beach and kids club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located within the hotel, our classic one bedroom apartments offer a fully equipped kitchen, dining space and views of the Palm residences with access to all hotel facilities including gym, outdoor pools, private beach and kids club.

verified_facts.text: The Family 3 Bedroom Deluxe Palm Sea View Suite has three bedrooms, a walk-in wardrobe, marble bathrooms, a dining and lounge area and a kitchenette.
verified_facts.excerpt: This spacious family suite with its Arabic touches, offers 3 bedrooms, a walk-in wardrobe, marble bathrooms, a dining and lounge area, kitchenette and panoramic views of the Marina skyline and the Palm from the privacy of your balcony.

verified_facts.text: The Signature Jacuzzi Suite has a private balcony with a jacuzzi overlooking the Arabian Gulf.
verified_facts.excerpt: This elegant suite offers separate dining and lounge areas as well as a private balcony with a jacuzzi ovelooking breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.

verified_facts.text: Frevo is a Brazilian restaurant where meats are carved tableside in southern Brazilian style.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe rooms have views of the Palm and the Dubai Marina skyline and a private balcony.
